title: Introducing ChatSUTRA
excerpt: ChatSUTRA is multilingual AI assistant, powered by SUTRA models, and serving 50+ languages for natural conversations and advanced AI features on iOS, Android and Web. Within short time, it crossed 1M+ users worldwide.

title: Two Platform powers AI Search on Jio AI Cloud
excerpt: In May'25, our multimodal AI stack was deployed on Jio AI Cloud serving their 400M+ user base. Handled massive scale processing of petabytes (400M users, 5K average files/user) with custom text-image models and vector indexes.

title: SUTRA Avatar: Realtime AI Video Calls
excerpt: SUTRA Avatar is a video foundation model service that enabled the creation of lifelike, customizable digital avatars with real-time video calling capabilities at scale on mobile devices. It is designed for enterprise applications across customer service, education, entertainment etc.

title: Understanding SUTRA's Multilingual Tokenizer
excerpt: We designed and trained a multilingual tokenizer for SUTRA to reduce the computational cost of LLMs while efficiently supporting diverse languages with a balanced vocabulary. The tokenizer improved representation efficiency and model performance, particularly for non-English languages, making multilingual LLMs more practical and cost-effective to train and serve.

title: Introducing SUTRA: The Next Frontier in Multilingual AI
excerpt: A cutting-edge multilingual AI architecture designed to deliver exceptional performance across 50+ languages. By separating concept learning from language learning, SUTRA enhances scalability, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities, setting a new standard for generative AI models.

title: Two Platforms powers Jio VIP Box at IPL 2023
excerpt: During IPL 2023, AutoCameo delivered over 300,000 personalized video messages to fans through the Jio VIP Box experience. It handled high request volumes efficiently, generating more than 2 million views and strong social media engagement.

title: $20M seed round on 2/22/22
excerpt: Our team is exhilarated to have raised a funding round of $20M with investments from Jio and NAVER.

title: NEON: Building Artificial Humans at Samsung STAR Labs
excerpt: NEON is a digital human generation platform developed at Samsung STAR Labs. At its core was CORE R3 — Reality, Realtime, Responsive, which focused on generating photorealistic digital humans and their behavior in real time, while SPECTRA was envisioned as the intelligence layer for learning, memory, emotion, and personalization.

title: Samsung STAR Labs and CJ sign MoU
excerpt: STAR Labs signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with CJ OliveNetworks on the Oct 23, 2020 to collaborate on the artificial human business. CJ plans to proactively respond to the rapidly evolving media content industry by leveraging NEON; as a first step, the company intends to collaborate with a virtual influencer to create new forms of content.

title: SARAM & Ballie — Physical AI and Robotics
excerpt: Architected the Physical AI stack for Samsung's SARAM robotic platform and Ballie companion robot, bringing together perception, multimodal interaction, motion planning, and real-time control for robots operating around people.

title: On-Device AI for Samsung Galaxy Devices
excerpt: Architected Samsung's on-device AI platform (Bixby Vision), which was launched with Galaxy S8, powering 100M+ devices worldwide.
